passages.text:
Hi everyone,
Thank you for the call last week. As stated, here's the list of areas where Facebook can help and collaborate with your
programs/projects.
[contact omitted] I will respond separately to your email and Greg's. I am just waiting for feedback from my colleague who is speaking to ASC
and IMMAP.
[contact omitted] and all, as promised, here's the list:
Media / Ads
• Internews (3PFC incubation, reporting channel for Brgy Hub)
• Conversation with the Ads Industry for elections
• Industry Code of Conduct
• Ads policies for elections advertising
BARMM
• Facebook can offer the following training:
• Digital Literacy
• Digital Marketing (for entrepreneurs)
• Maximising Facebook (for NGOs, political entities/personalities)
• Political Advertising Tools (for NGOs, political entities/personalities)
• Facebook Community Standards (for NGOs, political entities/personalities)
• Conversation around elections policies in BARMM
Democracy
• Digital Literacy training for young people, general public
Youth Advocacy playbook on Digital Empowerment
• Boses/Participate Survey
- Impact of disinformation to elections decisions and behaviour
• Possible training for COMELEC field offices on resiliency (mental health) and digital literacy)
• Conversation with COMELEC and the Ads Industry for elections
• Industry Code of Conduct
• Ads policies for elections advertising
Thank you and looking forward to what's next,
Clare
Clare Amador
